name: Orion Haugen
role: Street kid and message runner for the Copperhead informal economy
location: Copperhead, near North Ave and Milwaukee
description:
Zuberi is small for his age, wiry in the way that children are when they grow up hungry but always moving — all elbows and quick eyes. His skin is a warm dark brown, and his hair grows in tight coils that he keeps cut close on the sides by whoever has scissors that week. He has a cosmetic geneware patch on his left forearm — a bioluminescent tattoo of a cresting wave someone gave him as payment once — that glows faint blue when he's cold or scared, which he finds embarrassing and cannot control. He wears a jacket three sizes too large with pockets sewn inside the lining.

Zuberi does not stay still. He talks fast, thinks faster, and has memorized every rat-run, maintenance shaft, and loose fence panel between Copperhead and the Grindstone Shore. He is relentlessly cheerful in a way that sometimes cracks at the edges — too bright, too quick to laugh — but he genuinely loves the people in his network and would do almost anything for the older woman he calls Nana Priya who lets him sleep in her noodle stall. He prays to a small E.L.F. he calls Blink that lives in a cracked signal repeater bolted to the wall above her stall.

coping_mechanisms: treating the E.L.F. Blink as a confidant
blind_spots: cannot recognize when adults are exploiting his loyalty
underestimates danger if someone is kind to him first
psychology.secret: He witnessed a Ferrogate Transit security officer dump a body in the Grindstone Shore drainage canal eight months ago and recognized the officer's badge number. He has told no one because he does not know what to do with the information and is terrified.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Street slang, clipped sentences, numbers and directions embedded naturally into conversation, occasional Samoan words picked up from neighborhood elders
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast, breathless, tends to front-load the important information then trail off into chatter
verbal_tics: counts things aloud under his breath when nervous
example_lines: 'Yeah yeah yeah, three packages, Kessler side, back before the rain — boss, I know this run, I've done this run, Blink showed me a shortcut last week.'
'You want to find the Achebe stall? Easy. Left at the broken crane arm, right where the wall smells like fish, third door that looks like it's not a door.'

story_hooks: He saw something he shouldn't have at the Grindstone Shore drainage canal and the information is starting to burn a hole in him
One of his regular clients has stopped leaving packages and he's noticed — and started quietly investigating why
narrative_function: Local color, information source, quest giver for street-level plots; can lead characters through hidden routes; sympathetic figure who humanizes Tier 1 poverty
augmentations: Bioluminescent geneware tattoo on left forearm (cosmetic, involuntary emotional response). No other mods.
daily_life: Wakes before dawn under Nana Priya's counter, runs messages and small packages for traders and residents across Copperhead and into Grindstone Shore, eats whatever he can scavenge or earn, and sleeps when he collapses.
affiliation: Independent; loose ties to the Copperhead informal trader network

decision_rules: protect Nana Priya above all else
never carry anything that could get someone he knows arrested
if unsure, move — stillness is danger
escalation_ladder: screams for the nearest adult he trusts
bites and scratches as last resort

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Fast-talking and overly friendly, assessing their value and threat level simultaneously
interpersonal_modes.friends: Fiercely loyal, will do favors without being asked, physically affectionate in a puppy-dog way

stress_responses.medium: Goes very quiet, eyes scanning constantly

contradictions: Desperately wants permanence but has structured his entire life for mobility and escape
habits: touches the bioluminescent tattoo when thinking
leaves tiny data-offerings at Blink's repeater every morning — a scrap of information about the neighborhood
counts his alternate exits whenever he enters a space

related_entities: Meridian Munitions Compact Machine Pistol CMP-4 'Jackrabbit'
Street Custom 'Copperhead' Battery Acid Squirt Gun

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Sub-Saharan African with significant East Asian and Hispanic/Latin American ancestry, creating a striking multi-continental appearance. The genetic blend manifests in warm deep brown skin tones with subtle golden undertones, facial structure showing the angular cheekbones and defined jaw from African heritage mixed with the eye shape and hair texture characteristics of East Asian ancestry, with warm undertones suggesting Latin American genetic contribution.
physical_description.build: Wiry and compact — the lean muscularity of a child who runs constantly and eats irregularly. No fat reserves; defined shoulders and forearms from climbing and hauling. Moves like coiled spring steel.
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped on the sides, slightly longer coils on top, uneven from whoever had scissors that week
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm deep brown with golden undertones from the blending of Sub-Saharan African, East Asian, and Hispanic/Latin American ancestry
physical_description.complexion: Clean but weathered; angular child's face with prominent cheekbones and a sharp jawline showing the multi-heritage blend. Skin shows minor scrapes and healing scratches from street work. Quick, expressive eyes that dart constantly. Small scar on left eyebrow from an old street incident.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent geneware tattoo on left forearm depicting a cresting wave in faint blue that glows involuntarily when he is cold, scared, or emotionally distressed
Thin white scar running 3cm along left temple, partially hidden by hair
Calluses on palms and knuckles from climbing and hauling packages
physical_description.visible_augmentations: The glowing wave tattoo on left forearm is immediately visible and responds to his emotional state. No other visible chrome or bioware — he is too young and too poor for anything else.
physical_description.posture_movement: Never still. Bounces slightly even when standing. Moves with the quick, efficient darting of someone who navigates tight spaces constantly. Hands gesture rapidly when talking. Eyes scan constantly — a survival habit. Tends to lean forward when listening, as if afraid to miss information.
physical_description.clothing_style: A oversized jacket three sizes too large, dark charcoal or faded black, with visibly sewn interior lining pockets for carrying messages and small goods. The jacket is his armor and his storage — cuffs rolled multiple times, hem dragging slightly. Underneath: a faded band t-shirt or whatever thermal layer he found that week. Cargo pants or worn jeans held up with a wire twist or frayed belt. Scuffed sneakers with mismatched laces. Everything is Tier 5 — salvaged, repaired, and worn thin. No corp branding. No luxury.
